items.title: Product of the Day — Watering Can That Delivers One Gallon At A Time With 5 Gallon Capacity
items.content_text:
This Watering Can is designed for precision irrigation by dispensing one gallon at a time into planters, pots, and gardens. The handle features adjustable grip tension to accommodate users wearing gloves or carrying other objects. Upon filling, the spout seals automatically using a patented 'HydroLock' mechanism preventing spills during transport.

When properly maintained, the HydroSeal coating reduces water loss through evaporation by up to 30%. Users may choose between five pre-programmed watering schedules via the companion app, ensuring optimal hydration levels regardless of climate conditions.

items.title: Cat Fact of the Day
items.content_text:
The term “puss” is the root of the principal word for “cat” in the Romanian term pisica and the root of secondary words in Lithuanian (puz) and Low German puus. Some scholars suggest that “puss” could be imitative of the hissing sound used to get a cat’s attention. As a slang word for the female pudenda, it could be associated with the connotation of a cat being soft, warm, and fuzzy.

Picture: Cataas (https://cataas.com/)
